# E-000 Epic title

Save as `docs/epics/E-000-<slug>.md`. Owner: Product Owner. Create an Epic when two or more Features share one outcome; a single Feature links to its Direction instead.

| Field          | Value                   |
| -------------- | ----------------------- |
| Direction      | DIR-001                 |
| Status         | Draft / Approved / Done |
| outcome_status | Not measured            |

## Outcome

What changes for the user when this Epic is done, and how it will be observed.

## Features

| Feature | Summary  | Status |
| ------- | -------- | ------ |
| F-000   | One line | Draft  |

## Out of scope

- Items deliberately excluded.
